cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded travel card with SpiceJet offering discounts on flight bookings, accelerated points on travel spends, and complimentary add-on perks for domestic flyers.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: 15% off up to INR 500 on EazyDiner.|Minimum Order Value INR 2500
benefitRows.howToAvail: Select the restaurant to be paid on the EazyDiner app.|Enter the amount, and select the offer.|Discount will be applied and net payment will be required to be made.

benefitRows.name: Spicejet
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this voucher, log in at https://axisbankaura.poshvine.com using your registered mobile number, enter the OTP sent to your phone, select your SpiceJet voucher from the available benefits, and redeem it online at www.spicejet.com.
